morgan: Quick report: reproducible ESM/CJS resolution mismatch across Vite/Rollup/Webpack when targeting edge runtimes. Short repro below.

sam: What error do you see at runtime?

morgan: Two common runtime hits: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` (ESM landed where CJS expected) or `ReferenceError: require is not defined` (CJS wrapper ended up in ESM-only runtime).

anya: Minimal publish layout we used: `type: "module"`, exports map: ```json
{
  "exports": {".": {"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}}
}```
App import: `import SDK from 'redwood-inference-sdk'`. Build with Vite (esbuild), Rollup, Webpack default -> fail when run under Miniflare/edge emulator.

sam: Short-term workarounds I tested: 1) explicit path import `import SDK from 'redwood-inference-sdk/dist/esm/index.js'` 2) add `worker` condition to exports e.g. `"worker": "./dist/edge/index.mjs"` 3) ship a tiny CJS shim that safely delegates to ESM.

morgan: Agree. UX impact: we can't ask app authors to tweak resolve.conditions. We should: add an `edge`/`worker` export condition, include a tiny compatibility shim (CJS->ESM interop), and add examples in CI for vite/webpack/rollup that run against Miniflare.

ci-bot: Filed DX-1207. Please attach a minimal monorepo with three example apps and a GH Action matrix to catch regressions. Suggested labels: sdk-packaging, edge-compat.

anya: I'll scaffold the examples and paste build logs here. Also will add a TS type-resolution check since mismatched `types` can confuse bundlers.

sam: Once examples are up I'll try small changes to `resolve.conditionNames` for each bundler and share patches we can upstream to the SDK build.

morgan: Thanks — will follow up with the repo link and raw logs in this thread.
